instruction.thesis: BTC spot has drifted to 77,859, down -0.20% from entry at 78,018 with only 34h remaining before expiry. The position is approaching the -1.5% stop. More critically, the BTC 30d options IV has spiked from 38.6 to 46.6 in the last two snapshots while 90d IV collapsed from 40.3 to 29.3 — this term structure inversion (near-term vol >> long-term vol) suggests the market is pricing a near-term event risk rather than the clean vol-compression-reversion setup that H-523 requires. The promoted hypothesis H-523 expected PM IV compression to resolve upward with spot following; instead we are seeing near-term options IV spike without spot participation, which is inconsistent with the thesis. With limited time remaining and the stop close, closing to preserve capital.
